analysis.overall: You spent a solid 83% of your day in range, though it came with a couple of sharp swings—particularly a high morning peak that turned into a rapid drop after stacked corrections.

events.title: Afternoon meal bump & quick correction
events.description: Your 45g meal pushed readings up to a peak of 210 mg/dL, but a few micro-corrections brought you smoothly back into range within an hour.

events.title: Gentle evening dip
events.description: Glucose drifted down to 65 mg/dL, but using a temporary target helped you recover back to safe levels without overshooting.

events.title: Bedtime elevation
events.description: A late meal bolus was followed by a rise to 195 mg/dL, requiring several small correction doses over two hours before leveling off.

events.title: Morning spike and rapid drop
events.description: Glucose climbed to 221 mg/dL around breakfast, but stacking multiple correction boluses alongside your meal dose caused a quick drop down to 61 mg/dL two hours later.

events.title: Steady midday baseline
events.description: After recovering from the morning low, your glucose coasted in a beautifully flat line around 90-100 mg/dL for the rest of the afternoon.

analysis.watch_for_tomorrow: Be mindful when giving multiple small correction boluses close together during high spikes, as the combined insulin tail can trigger a sharp drop once it kicks in.
